boundaries.fallback: Use the Q1 declared plan anchor and preparation scenario. If the converter operation is modeled, propagate its simulated finish into readiness.
boundaries.interpretation: Observed tapping phase starts and stops are support for tapping service only. The planned converter phase does not establish a same-semantic tapping start.

boundaries.fallback: Keep Q1 conditional slag occupancy and retain the holder until a legal downstream transfer. Start the declared operation on arrival; its finish is endogenous.
boundaries.interpretation: Same-stage first slag start and end support separate service duration. Neither timestamp identifies crane drop completion or external receiving availability.

boundaries.fallback: Preserve pending EF confirmation or the Q1 blocked boundary until receiving point, next holder and legal release are approved.
boundaries.interpretation: Arrival and seat records evidence observed actions. They do not identify the release of an individually authorized transfer resource.

boundaries.fallback: Retain blocked or an approved fixed external handoff; preserve real same-ladle dependencies, previous occupancy and known routes.
boundaries.interpretation: Repair seat-to-lift can mix occupied service, queues and transfer waits. A historical return action does not prove availability in a future decision.

boundaries.fallback: Derive seating, preparation and occupancy from the Q1 plan and resource graph. Sample the calibrated casting service separately.
boundaries.interpretation: Seat-to-start mixes preparation and wait. Adding its observed interval or the observed start error as new noise would duplicate internal queueing and preparation.

external_boundary.count_rule: canonical, valid parsed seconds and unique or identity-resolved link
external_boundary.scope: external interface evidence and dependency rules; not a strategy observation stream

cast_start_plan_error.reason: Historical caster start is an endogenous response to preparation and resource readiness.

tap_end_plan_error.reason: Historical actual tap completion minus planned converter end. Phase semantics differ.

timing_fields.actual_time_s: Simulator actual execution clock; historical realized values stay in private audit.
timing_fields.announced_at_s: Evidence of an announcement; not inferred from historical operation time.
timing_fields.plan_time_s: Plan target; enforce only with the inherited Q1 evidence and authority.
timing_fields.predicted_time_s: Conditioned on a currently visible state, with a model version and time issued.
timing_fields.visible_at_s: Decision availability inherited from Q1; no future-actual leakage.

evidence.kinematics_basis: Frozen Q1 assumed 0.10 reference-unit/s at the base scale; B stage02 scenario ramp and approach ratios; no calibration from transport timestamps

policy_parameters.buffer_rule: max(0, Qp - mean); multiply by plan_mean_s for ratio strata
policy_parameters.fallback_rule: metric/device/route -> metric/device -> metric/pool -> no calibrated fit

sidecar_protocol.block_draw: Choose donor using a frozen group key and map events to fixed ranks before dispatch.
sidecar_protocol.exposure: Policy receives training prediction parameters and visible simulator notices only.
sidecar_protocol.seed_encoding: First 16 SHA-256 bytes as a big-endian integer of compact UTF-8 JSON [master_seed,replicate_id,heat_id,process_stage,event_id,device_id]
